AUTO-07p labels a zero of its residual-contaminated cusp stencil away from the analytic cusp (u1=0.5,u2=2,p0=exp(-2),p1=12). Its FNCPAE adds F(u+h*v)+F(u-h*v) without subtracting 2*F(u), toolboxae.f90:838-845. W364 removes the finite Newton residual before division by h^2; ours finds the true cusp, reference CP index 3. See docs/auto07p-findings.md, finding 2.
